arguments.subject: distribution records
arguments.body:
Hi Eric,

The distribution owners you represent hold years of order, shipment and customer history. Sellers rarely think about their records until a buyer asks, and some of that history has value to technology and research buyers on top of the sale price.

We run a free two-minute estimate that shows an owner what their business records could be worth. Nothing goes to a buyer without the owner's OK, and we can discuss a referral arrangement.

Would a short note you can forward to a seller be useful?

If this isn't relevant, reply "no" and I won't follow up.

Alex Starr
Mesa Data Labs
[postal address]
